question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

UBEJ, VEJQ, ?, XKTE, YNYL
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/768ffa75a91f088695c16a6deb50b713a526fcdb17ebb80961c20654cb850baa.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Letters are increasing in the order +1, +3, +5, +7.**

On continuing the pattern, we get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/942bc69beee0b06e7ffaab7b7584196ab26f1a905527b71054010ee60c2c8b59.png] 

Hence, ‘**WHOX**’ is the correct answer.
